subject: general
question: Which is the second official language of Telangana?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Urdu__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Urdu is the 2nd Official language of Telangana.
 
• Telugu, one of the traditional languages of India, is the official language of Telangana.
 
• 77% of Telangana's population speaks Telugu and 12% speak Urdu.
 
• Until **1948**, Urdu became the official language of the State of Hyderabad and, due to the shortage of Telugu-language educational establishments, Urdu became the language of the educated class in Telangana.
 
• After 1948, when the Hyderabad State entered the new Republic of India, Telugu became the language of government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The primary language of Telangana, T**elugu is also an official language of Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• It is a **classical language of India and a member of the Dravidian language family**.
 
• Telugu is the fourth most spoken language in India, after Hindi, Bengali, and Marathi. 
 
• Telugu was adopted as a medium of education in schools and colleges, the use of Urdu among non-Hyderabad Muslims decreased.
 
• The operation done by Indian armed forces to make Hyderabad the part of India was Operation Polo.
